narration.text: A mother-to-be's leave for a caesarean birth is lined up: twelve weeks of job-protected leave, eight weeks of disability pay on the doctor's certificate and four of paid family leave from the day after it ends, while an early start, a split leave, a partner's weeks, overlaps and a claim past the year are left out, across five portals. This is a chore for a project coordinator at a print works in Rochester, New York, due in November with a planned caesarean, who has read a parent guide and a note from her partner. On the bench, she found 3 of 3 eligible items, worth 5,585 dollars and 20 cents of the 5,585 dollars and 20 cents there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 83 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
